heading: Incentive for fishermen to collect and dispose of plastic found at sea

tree.heading: In general
tree.text: The Under Secretary shall establish a pilot program to assess the feasibility and advisability of providing incentives, such as grants, to fishermen based in the United States who incidentally capture marine debris while at sea—

children.text: to track or keep the debris on board; and
to dispose of the debris properly on land.

tree.heading: Support for collection and removal of derelict gear
tree.text: The Under Secretary shall encourage United States efforts, such as the Fishing for Energy net disposal program, that support—

children.text: collection and removal of derelict fishing gear and other fishing waste;
disposal or recycling of such gear and waste; and
prevention of the loss of such gear.
